source_selection.scope: direct live IsoSprite children of forest world, excluding exact village.town_trees membership
source_selection.ownership: Only successfully installed native instances suppress source cards; unsupported definitions and missing meshes keep their fallback
source_selection.collision: Existing village.circles and SpatialWorld3D cylinders remain authoritative and unchanged

placement.source_key: sheet|source frame as Godot Array string|global x,y with six decimal source pixels|flip as 0 or 1
placement.seed: FNV-1a UTF-8, offset 2166136261, prime 16777619, mask 0xffffffff after each byte
placement.variant: FNV-1a seed modulo 5; existing broadleaf 2 + fir, black pine, cypress
placement.size: 원본 수관 상한 안에서 변형별 폭 비율 [1,1,0.68,0.86,0.52]을 적용하고 원본 높이·뿌리·충돌을 보존한다.
placement.layout_record: NativeForestTrees metadata native_forest_tree_layout: JSON-safe per-source position, key, frame, foot, k, flip, variant, yaw, native basis, native position, measured crown size and original collision radius

batching.chunk_bounds: Merge complete transformed mesh AABBs in chunk-local space, including full crowns and terrain height, plus 0.02 m rounding margin

budget.leaf_material: Lit, double-sided alpha-scissor, fixed curved 3D spray orientations; not a camera-facing billboard
budget.shadow: Actual native directional-light shadows enabled; requires actual device overdraw/shadow review
budget.scope: 기존 활엽수 2종의 상한·텍스처 기준. 새 침엽수와 관목의 개별 수치는 additional_budget과 additional_mesh_provenance를 따른다.

limitations: 새 침엽수 3종은 원본 수관보다 좁고 뾰족한 실루엣을 사용한다. 기존 줄기 충돌과 발치 높이는 바꾸지 않는다.
A spatial chunk is culled as a unit, including crowns crossing its cell. A draw-count reduction does not establish faster frame time
Source-sized native tree fitting inherits the existing town-tree positive radial/vertical fitting; no new camera-facing geometry or flattening is introduced
Runtime portrait/landscape, two-axis full-crown, actual terrain contact, alpha/shadow cost and representative combat performance require engine/browser validation

additional_budget.placement: 원본 나무 4그루마다 1개, 기존 줄기 충돌 반경 안의 장식; 새 장애물 없음
